headline: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012, Havertz scores the only goal
facts: Arsenal beat Liverpool 1-0 at Anfield on 1 November; Havertz scored in the 16th minute from a Rice cross.
ESPN's match page calls it Arsenal's first Anfield win since 2012 and their 300th Premier League away win, which put them three points clear.
Liverpool did not register a shot on target, and the page notes an Alisson error in the first half.
background: Arsenal were the Premier League champions in 2025/26 with 85 points, per ESPN's season preview; Liverpool had won the title a year earlier before finishing fifth.
footage_terms: Liverpool vs Arsenal 1-0 highlights Havertz Anfield
Arsenal Anfield first win since 2012 reaction
Arteta post match press conference Liverpool

headline: Saka out about another month with a thigh problem while Saliba is finally fit again
facts: Arteta said Saka needs roughly four more weeks; he hurt his left thigh early in the 21 October Champions League draw with Bayern Munich.
Saliba has been out since the World Cup with a back injury, has played two practice matches and is fit; Arteta plans to build his minutes slowly.
Arsenal lead the Premier League by five points after 10 games.
background: Arsenal won the 2025/26 Premier League title, and Saliba and Gabriel were the centre-back pair in that season, per Sky.
footage_terms: Arteta press conference Saka injury update

headline: Declan Rice agrees a new five-year Arsenal contract in principle
facts: ESPN sources say Rice agreed in principle to a deal that runs to 2031 with a significant pay rise; nothing is signed yet.
His current contract ends after next season with a club option for one more year.
Rice told reporters on England duty that a new contract was 'hopefully on the horizon'.
background: Rice joined Arsenal from West Ham in 2023 for 105 million pounds, per ESPN. ESPN ranked him seventh in its November list of the world's best players.

headline: League Two Fleetwood knock Arsenal out of the Carabao Cup on penalties
facts: The fourth-round tie ended 1-1 and Fleetwood won the shootout 5-3; Guimaraes had his penalty saved.
Arteta said later that a drone stopped the match for eight minutes.
The ESPN match page lists conflicting goalscorer data, so only the score and shootout are used here.
background: Fleetwood are a League Two side; Arsenal had beaten Ipswich 4-2 in the previous round, per ESPN's results page.
footage_terms: Fleetwood vs Arsenal penalty shootout highlights
Fleetwood Town beat Arsenal Carabao Cup

headline: Arteta bans players from picking themselves in FPL after Tzolis leaked his own start
facts: Tzolis picked and captained himself in Fantasy Premier League before the Liverpool match, which signalled he had recovered and would start.
The next week he transferred himself, Konsa and Calafiori out of his team.
Arteta said Arsenal have taken steps to stop leaks and players will no longer select themselves.
Chelsea issued a similar warning to staff after João Pedro was dropped from FPL teams.
background: Fantasy Premier League is the official game that millions play, and managers hide team news until the last moment, so a player's own picks can reveal it.
footage_terms: Arteta press conference fantasy premier league leaks

headline: Arsenal reportedly want Athletic Club winger Nico Williams
facts: ESPN's roundup, citing TEAMtalk, says Arsenal have renewed interest and Williams is reportedly open to a move.
The article cites a 100 million euro release clause; he signed a 10-year extension last summer.
Other reported Arsenal wing targets are Endrick, Nusa, Kevin Schade and Alex Baena.
background: Williams is a World Cup winner with Spain, per ESPN. Arsenal's Saka is out injured for about another month.
footage_terms: Nico Williams Spain World Cup highlights

headline: Arsenal's Max Dowman, 16, becomes England's youngest Under-21 goalscorer
facts: Dowman scored a late winner in England's 3-2 win over France at Ashton Gate.
England led 2-0 through Mikey Moore and Divin Mubama, then let France draw level at 2-2.
The win followed a 1-0 loss to Portugal three days earlier.
background: Dowman is a 16-year-old Arsenal forward who also appeared in the senior team's Carabao Cup tie at Fleetwood, per ESPN.
footage_terms: Max Dowman England U21 goal France

headline: Arsenal ready to sell a midfielder to beat Chelsea and Liverpool to Alex Scott
facts: Sky reports Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool all like the 23-year-old Bournemouth midfielder; a deal could come in January or next summer.
Bournemouth reportedly want close to 100 million pounds including add-ons, though 75 to 80 million plus bonuses may be enough.
Arsenal would need to sell a current midfielder; Mikel Merino, with one league start this season, is seen as the likeliest.
background: Scott's Liverpool appeal comes partly from his history under Andoni Iraola, who managed Bournemouth until this summer.

headline: Vinicius Junior says Arsenal transfer talk left him 'overwhelmed' and hurt his form
facts: Vinicius, 26, has one goal in 12 appearances this season and blamed part of the slump on transfer speculation.
He also said Brazil's early World Cup exit in July meant he trained less in his break.
He signed a new Real Madrid deal in August that runs to at least 2032, and served a four-match ban after a red card against Villarreal.
background: Arsenal were among clubs linked with him when his contract entered its final year, according to ESPN.

headline: Mudryk, on loan at Spurs, calls Arsenal his dream club on a podcast
facts: Mudryk, on loan at Spurs from Chelsea, said on the Guest of Gordon podcast that Arsenal was the club he wanted and that he nearly joined in 2023.
Spurs fans were reportedly irritated and the club did not know about the podcast.
De Zerbi defended him as a good person and declined to say whether the loan could end in January.
Mudryk has played 16 minutes since arriving on deadline day and has an ankle injury, with two to three weeks to go before training.
background: The podcast also touched on his drugs ban, which the article does not detail; he is on loan at Spurs from Chelsea.
footage_terms: Mudryk Tottenham De Zerbi press conference

headline: David Raya is called the Premier League's best goalkeeper and is close to a new Arsenal deal
facts: Raya has seven clean sheets in 10 league games and has not conceded a 'saveable' goal this season, per Gradient Sports data.
Martinez, Alisson and Donnarumma have conceded three, four and five saveable goals.
He received the most FIFPRO World XI votes, 10,278, though Unai Simon won the Ballon d'Or goalkeeper award.
Sky says Arsenal are close to giving him a new contract; ESPN's roundup cites The Athletic saying terms are agreed.
background: Raya joined Arsenal from Brentford in 2023 and has kept clean sheets in nearly half of his 117 Premier League games for the club.

headline: Bruno Guimaraes faces his old club Newcastle as Arteta still wants more
facts: Arteta described him as a 75 million pound signing and said he has 'still not' reached his full level.
Guimaraes scored against Sunderland and Leeds and ranks near the top for ground-duel success, behind only Chelsea's Romeo Lavia.
Arsenal visit Newcastle on Saturday 21 November at 5:30pm.
Arteta wants more close-range goals from him.
background: Guimaraes captained Newcastle to cup success and scored nine Premier League goals last season, according to Sky.

headline: Chelsea 11 points behind Arsenal after ten Premier League games under Alonso
facts: Chelsea have four league defeats, including heavy losses at Brentford and defeats at Tottenham and Sunderland, but also won 5-1 against Bournemouth and 4-3 against Brighton.
They have used six different central midfield pairings and Sky links the problem to selling Enzo Fernandez without a replacement.
Alonso has switched between a back three and a back four; possession was only 26% against Brighton and 31% against Spurs.
Sky calls Chelsea 'consistently inconsistent'.
background: Alonso is a former Liverpool midfielder, and Chelsea sit 11 points behind leaders Arsenal but are well placed for a Champions League place, per Sky.

headline: Sunderland beat Chelsea 1-0 and Alonso denies his team were 'bullied'
facts: Enzo Le Fee scored a 36th-minute penalty after Brobbey was brought down following a tussle with Colwill.
It was Chelsea's fourth league defeat of the season and dropped them out of the top four; it was Sunderland's first league win since August.
A Chelsea penalty appeal for a challenge on Palmer was ruled outside the box by VAR.
Alonso said his side could have defended better and that the team misses the injured João Pedro.
background: Chelsea had also lost at home to Tottenham on 24 October, their first home defeat under Alonso.

headline: Chelsea warn staff over fantasy football after João Pedro was quietly dropped from FPL teams
facts: ESPN sources say Chelsea reminded Cobham staff that FPL moves can reveal injuries or tactics.
Outsiders reportedly noticed Rogers and other Chelsea staff dropping João Pedro before the club confirmed he was injured.
Alonso said afterward that he does not follow fantasy football.
background: João Pedro was absent from the 2-0 home loss to Tottenham on 24 October without any pre-match announcement.

headline: Emiliano Martinez returns for Argentina in a protective mask after jaw surgery
facts: Martinez was hurt in a collision with Everton defender Jarrad Branthwaite during Chelsea's 2-0 win on 16 October and had jaw surgery.
He trained in a protective mask about two weeks later, but Alonso called a return before the international break 'too rash and too risky'.
Scaloni confirmed he would play in the friendly against Costa Rica.
background: Mike Penders took Martinez's place in goal while he was out, and impressed according to Sky.
footage_terms: Emiliano Martinez mask Argentina Costa Rica

headline: Morgan Rogers calls claims Palmer does not want England a 'lie'
facts: Rogers told BBC Radio 5 Live after England's 2-1 win over Croatia that Palmer 'wants to be here'.
Palmer withdrew from the autumn squad with a minor muscle injury, and Tuchel then suggested he had missed chances to impress him.
Palmer has played three times for England in two years and Tuchel left him out of the Croatia and Spain games.
Tuchel said Rogers was entitled to speak as a friend and teammate.
background: Rogers and Palmer are Chelsea teammates and longtime friends, and Rogers has started all ten league games for Chelsea this season.

headline: Estevao becomes a bench player at Chelsea in his second season
facts: He has started once in the first 10 league games, in the 2-0 win over Manchester United, and otherwise came off the bench or did not play.
Alonso prefers a 3-4-3 that suits him poorly, and Palmer and Rogers compete for his spot.
Ancelotti still starts him for Brazil; both of his goals after the World Cup came in friendlies against India and Singapore.
Alonso says there are no plans to move him on.
background: Estevao scored eight goals in 36 games in his debut season, which ESPN describes as strong.

headline: Palmer sent off as Spurs win at Stamford Bridge for the first time since 2018
facts: Tottenham won 2-0; Penders punched a corner into his own net in the 77th minute and Mathys Tel added a solo goal in the 87th.
Palmer received a second yellow for a lunge at Conor Gallagher, leaving Chelsea with ten men.
It was Chelsea's first home defeat under Alonso and Spurs' first win at Stamford Bridge since April 2018.
background: Gallagher is a former Chelsea player, and Penders was making one of his early starts after the Martinez injury.
footage_terms: Chelsea 0-2 Tottenham highlights Palmer red card

headline: Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 as Lisandro Martinez is sent off
facts: Rogers scored early in the second half and Palmer added a penalty after United's Lisandro Martinez was sent off for a second yellow.
Estevao had a goal ruled out for offside after a VAR review.
The result left United without a win in nine matches.
background: Estevao's start in this game is his only league start in Chelsea's first ten games, per ESPN.

headline: Juan Mata retires at 38, ending a career with a World Cup and a Champions League win at Chelsea
facts: Mata announced his retirement in a video on X, writing 'Sometimes to love...is to let go. Thanks football.'
He won the 2010 World Cup and Euro 2012 with Spain.
At Chelsea he won the FA Cup and the Champions League in 2012; at Manchester United he won the FA Cup in 2016 and the Europa League in 2017.
background: Mata joined Chelsea from Valencia in 2011 and later moved to Manchester United.

headline: Joao Pedro still out as Chelsea struggle to score without him
facts: Alonso said Joao Pedro is not fit and is not part of training before the Leeds match on Saturday.
Sky's analysis says Chelsea scored only two goals in the four league games he has missed.
Sky ranked him ninth in its Premier League top 25 and credits him with 20 league goals and 28 goal involvements since the start of last season.
background: Joao Pedro has five goals and three assists in six league starts this season, per Sky.

headline: Andoni Iraola's Liverpool: more chaos, fewer goals conceded from set pieces
facts: Iraola replaced Slot in June and has managed 10 league games; Liverpool are fourth with two league defeats.
Possession is 52.9% compared with 59.3% under Slot, and long passes have risen to 50.8 per game.
Liverpool have conceded two goals from set pieces, compared with 23 under Slot last season.
Slot's team conceded 53 league goals last season, the most ever in a Premier League season for the club.
background: Iraola spent three successful seasons at Bournemouth before moving to Anfield, and Liverpool finished fifth in 2025/26, 24 points fewer than their 2024/25 title season.
footage_terms: Liverpool vs Manchester United preview Iraola

headline: Liverpool have won once at Anfield in the league and failed to register a shot on target against Arsenal
facts: In five home league games Liverpool have one win, two draws and two defeats for five points; only Crystal Palace and Nottingham Forest have fewer at home.
Against Arsenal they had no shot on target, the first such game in 442 league matches at Anfield.
Their away form is the best in the division, with four wins and a draw from five.
Man United arrive 18th and winless in eight league games, and have not won at Anfield since March 2023.
background: Liverpool's league home results this season include a 2-2 draw with Forest, a 0-0 draw with Fulham and a 1-0 defeat to Arsenal.
footage_terms: Liverpool vs Manchester United preview Anfield

headline: Iraola goes viral after visiting a grassroots kids' match in Maghull
facts: A photo of Iraola with two young players, posted by Maghull FC, passed a million views, with fans calling him a 'down-to-earth fella'.
He reportedly went to watch a relative play and spent time with other children, according to Maghull manager Joe Burns.
Earlier this year, while still at Bournemouth, he ran the line as an assistant referee at a local match.
background: The visit came during the international break, when much of Liverpool's first team was away with national sides.
footage_terms: Iraola assistant referee local match Bournemouth

headline: Andy Robertson, now at Spurs, becomes Scotland's most-capped player
facts: Robertson, 32, reached 103 caps in a Nations League match against Switzerland, passing Dalglish's 102.
He had equalled the record three days earlier against North Macedonia.
He said Dalglish deserved the record and called him the best player to represent Scotland.
background: Robertson played for Queen's Park, Dundee United, Hull City and Liverpool before joining Tottenham.

headline: Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties to reach the Carabao Cup quarter-finals
facts: The fourth-round tie at Anfield finished 1-1, with Rogers and Gakpo both scoring first-half penalties, and Liverpool won the shootout 6-5.
Liverpool had 33 shots to Chelsea's 17.
Chelsea missed three kicks in the shootout, including Barco's and a save from Emegha.
background: Alonso is a former Liverpool midfielder; ESPN's page notes it was his third defeat as Chelsea manager at Anfield.
footage_terms: Liverpool vs Chelsea Carabao Cup penalty shootout

headline: Fenerbahce come back twice to beat Liverpool 3-2 in the Champions League
facts: Fenerbahce won 3-2 in Istanbul; Greenwood, Archie Brown and substitute Muriqi scored.
Nyoni and Isak scored for Liverpool, who led twice.
The result ended Liverpool's perfect start in the competition and gave Fenerbahce their first points.
The page's shot map shows different scorers, so the scoreboard and commentary version is used.
background: Liverpool had won their first Champions League league-phase games, including 4-3 against Villarreal on 20 October.

headline: Isak leads Liverpool with seven league goals and is the most-owned Liverpool player in FPL
facts: Isak has seven Premier League goals, the team high, and only one player scored more in the first ten matches.
He is in 25.6% of FPL teams, and 526,590 managers brought him in before the Gameweek 10 deadline.
ESPN also names him Liverpool's second-most important player after Van Dijk.
background: Isak scored in Liverpool's 3-1 win at Crystal Palace on 8 November, and Wirtz and Barcola also scored or assisted in that match.

headline: Liverpool open contract talks with Mac Allister as Bayern eye Ngumoha
facts: ESPN's roundup, citing Cesar Luis Merlo, says Liverpool have opened talks with Mac Allister, whose deal runs to summer 2028.
TEAMtalk reports Bayern contacted Ngumoha's representatives; Liverpool reportedly have no plans to sell and his contract enters its final 18 months in January.
Caught Offside says Liverpool and Chelsea are competing for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara.
background: Mac Allister scored in the 3-1 win at Crystal Palace on 8 November.

headline: Premier League clubs vote 18-2 to protect board members if Manchester City's sponsors sue
facts: Clubs voted 18-2 to indemnify five board members against personal liability from defamation suits; City and Nottingham Forest voted against.
Etihad says it was not allowed to provide information and is seeking legal advice; Etisalat calls the findings false and defamatory.
An independent commission found City broke more than 100 league financial rules between 2009 and 2018 and said sham contracts inflated revenue by 830 million pounds; City is appealing.
background: Etihad Airways has sponsored City since 2009, according to Sky.
footage_terms: Manchester City Premier League verdict reaction
Premier League board members legal protection City case

headline: Haaland says he is 'incredibly happy' at City and not thinking about sanctions
facts: After Norway's 3-1 win over Wales, Haaland said his focus is on performing for the club and that he does not know much about the case.
ESPN reports an independent commission found City guilty of more than 100 breaches in September, including concealing more than 830 million pounds of funding between 2009 and 2018.
If the verdict stands, City could face heavy punishments, including large points deductions or relegation.
background: Haaland signed a five-year deal in 2022 and a nine-and-a-half-year deal in late 2024; the period under investigation predates his arrival.

headline: Manchester City lose three league games in a row, losing 3-1 at Nottingham Forest
facts: Forest won 3-1 at the City Ground, with Jair Cunha and two goals from Liam Delap; Cherki scored for City.
ESPN's commentary says a Gvardiol error led to the first goal.
It was City's third straight league loss after a 7-0-3 start, and they are six points behind Arsenal.
It was Forest's first home win of the season.
background: Maresca is in his first season in charge, and City had won seven straight in all competitions before the slide, per Sky.

headline: Maresca's City have spent over 320 million on midfield and Fernandez is the 'obvious problem'
facts: City spent over 320 million pounds rebuilding midfield this summer, and Sky says the two 100 million-plus signings have not yet worked well together.
At Forest, Fernandez made 4 defensive contributions compared with 14 for Xaver Schlager and 11 for Ryan Yates.
City have faced 17 shots from fast breaks, second only to Newcastle's 20.
Sky suggests Bouaddi as a screening No 6 and says City have won their last 17 meetings with Fulham.
background: Fernandez joined City from Chelsea this summer, and Sky notes his tackling and ball-winning numbers are lower than at Chelsea.

headline: Semenyo withdraws support for the prosecution of a Liverpool fan in a racial abuse case
facts: At Liverpool Magistrates' Court the prosecution offered no further evidence after Semenyo said he no longer supported the case, and a not guilty verdict was recorded.
The allegation concerned the Liverpool v Bournemouth match on 15 August 2025, when Semenyo was a Bournemouth player.
The trial began last month and was adjourned when the defendant was taken to hospital after a seizure.
background: Semenyo reported the incident to the referee at the time and joined Manchester City from Bournemouth in January 2026.

headline: Haaland is crowned Sky Sports' No 1 Premier League player ahead of Rice
facts: Haaland rose from fourth to first, with 14 league goals since March, almost double the next player, and replaced Bruno Fernandes, who fell to 11th.
Arsenal take places 2 to 4 with Rice, Raya and Gabriel; Cherki is 7th and Elliot Anderson 8th.
Chelsea's Joao Pedro is 9th and Cole Palmer 13th; Liverpool's Van Dijk is 15th and Alisson re-enters at 25th.
background: ESPN's own ranking in the same week had Haaland eighth in the world, saying he is less involved in build-up play than before.
footage_terms: Premier League top 25 players Sky Sports

headline: Haaland is one of four City captains and says fatherhood made leadership 'natural'
facts: City have four appointed captains this season: Haaland, Ruben Dias, Marc Guehi and Gianluigi Donnarumma.
Haaland said leading is now natural since he became a father and he tries to help new signings settle.
He scored a late winner against Denmark and a penalty against Wales for Norway.
City host Fulham on Saturday and then face Napoli in the Champions League.
background: He is in his fifth season at City and is now among the club's longest-serving players.

headline: Maresca's City win 3-0 at Anfield as Gravenberch is sent off
facts: City won 3-0 at Anfield after Gravenberch's second yellow on Doku around the 62nd minute; Haaland, Doku and Gvardiol scored.
The page says Maresca became only the fourth manager to win his first six Premier League matches.
Liverpool's xG was 0.86 to City's 1.30 and they dropped to ninth.
background: Maresca is in his first season as City manager, and City later lost three straight league games from late October, per ESPN.

headline: Man City reportedly set to lose Mateo Kovacic at the end of the season
facts: ESPN's roundup cites a Marca report dated 19 November that Kovacic will leave when his contract expires at the end of the season.
The same roundup links Chelsea with Inter's Alessandro Bastoni and Liverpool with Barcelona left back Alejandro Balde, a possible 40 million euro move.
background: The report is a single-source rumour carried by ESPN's transfer roundup, not an official club statement.
footage_terms: Mateo Kovacic Manchester City best moments
